metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: 1.5×ATR SL ensures SL is outside the M5 noise band (~1×ATR). 2.5×ATR TP gives 1.67:1 RR ratio. 5-bar horizon (25 min) matches micro strategy's short-horizon, fast-in/out nature. SL=1.5×ATR ≈ 1.5σ on M5 gold, giving <5% random-noise stop-out probability vs ~32% at 1.0×ATR.
metadata.design_notes: This contract shares the same survival_barrier methodology as label-survival-barrier-1.0.0 but with parameters tuned for the 3-25 minute micro-structure time scale. All micro brains (XGBoost V4.5, Transformer V5.0) should be retrained on labels generated from this contract to align live SL/TP with training targets.
